method: Each area's reference point and each station's position are OpenStreetMap coordinates. Stations are ranked by straight-line distance from the reference point. Distances are kept for audit and are not shown on the page; no walking time or last-mile route is claimed. Line 3 station status is media-reported and unverified. The brief's leads were checked, and two were corrected: Viman Nagar's closest station is Ramwadi, and Koregaon Park's are Bund Garden and Yerwada.

areas.name: Kharadi
areas.note: No metro station in Kharadi today. Ramwadi and Kalyani Nagar on Line 2 are the closest by straight line, and you need road transport to reach either. A Ramwadi-Wagholi extension is announced by the operator but is not built or open.

areas.name: Viman Nagar
areas.note: No metro station in Viman Nagar. Ramwadi is the closest Line 2 station by straight line, then Kalyani Nagar. Road transport is needed for the last stretch.

areas.name: Koregaon Park
areas.note: No station inside Koregaon Park. Bund Garden and Yerwada are the closest on Line 2 by straight line, then Kalyani Nagar and Ruby Hall Clinic.

areas.name: Camp and MG Road
areas.note: No station on MG Road. Pune Railway Station, Ruby Hall Clinic and R.T.O., Pune on Line 2 are the closest by straight line from the MG Road reference point.

areas.name: Deccan Gymkhana and FC Road
areas.note: Deccan Gymkhana station is in Deccan. FC Road is a long street: from Fergusson College the closest Line 2 stations by straight line are Chhatrapati Sambhaji Udyan, Deccan Gymkhana and Garware College. Pick the one nearer your end of the road.

areas.name: Kothrud
areas.note: Vanaz, the western end of Line 2, is the closest station to Kothrud's centre point. Anand Nagar and Paud Phata follow along the line.

areas.name: Shivajinagar
areas.note: Shivaji Nagar on Line 1 (Purple) is the closest station. PMC, Chhatrapati Sambhaji Udyan and District Court are next. A Line 3 station also called Shivaji Nagar is reported closed (media) and is kept as a separate station.

areas.name: Baner and Balewadi
areas.note: No Line 1 or Line 2 station is near Baner. The Line 3 stations at Baner Gaon, Balewadi Phata and Baner Pashan Link Road are reported not open yet, and Aundh is reported open; both are media reports the operator has not confirmed. Check punerimetro.in before travelling.

areas.name: Hinjawadi
areas.note: Line 3 (Pink) serves Hinjawadi. Its stations here are reported open since early November 2026, but only by media: the operator publishes no open list. The planner does not offer Line 3 stations until the operator confirms. No Line 1 or Line 2 station is near.

areas.name: Pune Airport
areas.note: There is no metro station at the airport. Ramwadi, the eastern end of Line 2, is the closest Maha Metro station by straight line. You need road transport for the rest.

areas.name: PCMC and Pimpri
areas.note: PCMC, the northern end of Line 1 (Purple), is the closest station to Pimpri. Sant Tukaram Nagar is next.
